name: Hangzhou Haoyue Personal Care Co., Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Haoyue Personal Care Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of hygiene products in China. It offers baby care products, including diapers and pants; feminine care products comprising sanitary pads, menstrual pads, and panty liners; adult care products that include adult diapers and pants, under pads, and incontinence pads; pet care products, such as pads, wipes, and gloves; and cleaning and personal care wipes. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
